                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಇಲ್ಲಿ, P = ಅಸಲು, T = ಸಮಯ, R = ದರ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    S.I = 18480 - 12000 = 6480
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ (12000 × T × 9)/100 = 6840
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1080T = 6480
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ T = 6480/1080 = 6
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ ಅವರು ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯಲು 6 ವರ್ಷಗಳ ಕಾಲ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    தொகை = ரூ. 12000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    வட்டி விகிதம் = 9%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட கருத்து:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    S.I = (P × T × R)/100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    தொகை = S.I + P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    இதில், P = தொகை, T = காலம், மற்றும் R = வட்டி விகிதம்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    கணக்கீடு:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    S.I = 18480 - 12000 = 6480

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ (12000 × T × 9)/100 = 6840

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1080T = 6480

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ T = 6480/1080 = 6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ அந்தத் தொகையைப் பெற அவர் 6 ஆண்டுகள் முதலீடு செய்தார்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n", "or": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ରାଶି = ଟଙ୍କା 12000

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ହାର = 9% 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଧାରଣା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    SI = (P x T x R) / 100

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ରାଶି = SI + P

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ଏଠାରେ, P = ମୂଳଧନ, T = ସମୟ, ଏବଂ R = ହାର 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ଗଣନା:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    SI = 18480 - 12000 = 6480

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ∴ (12000 x T x 9) / 100 = 6840

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ 1080T = 6480

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ⇒ T = 6480/1080 = 6

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Sidharth made earnest attempts / to change / for better, / but nothing happened.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "<span style="">to change</span>"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "<span style="">for better</span>"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "<span style="">Sidharth made earnest attempts</span>"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "<span style="">but nothing happened</span>"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The correct answer is "for better".

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Key Points  

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The marked answer is "for better", which is not grammatically correct in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The issue lies within the usage of the phrase "for better", which in standard and grammatically correct English, should be "for the better".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The phrase "for the better" is a common idiom in English that refers to a change resulting in a more positive outcome, improvement, or beneficial situation.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • The definite article "the" before "better" is necessary when speaking about general ideas of improvement.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Without "the", the phrase "for better" is not grammatically correct in this context.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Let's put this into the full sentence:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • "Sidharth made earnest attempts to change for better, but nothing happened."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Here, the sentence means that Sidharth made serious efforts to change and improve, but despite his attempts, there was no result or positive outcome.\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • However, as mentioned, "for better" is not correct in this sentence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It should be "for the better".
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Therefore, the correct sentence is:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • "Sidharth made earnest attempts to change for the better, but nothing happened."
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • This sentence correctly conveys that Sidharth made genuine efforts to improve his situation — or that he attempted to make changes that would have positive effects — but despite these efforts, there was no change.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Thus, the correct answer is "Option 2".
